localAgentsScope: The model runs on your Ollama server, with no cloud fallback. Tools keep their own network permissions; this is not a fully offline mode.
localAgentsContextHelp: Install tool-capable models in Ollama first. Configure the same num_ctx on each model. No models are downloaded automatically.
localAgentsSaveError: Unable to save. Check the private URL, model names and context size.
localAgentsUnavailable: Ollama or an allowed model is unavailable. Check Settings → Codex → Local agents. No cloud model will be used instead.
localAgentsLoadError: Unable to load local agent configuration.
localAgentsCreationHelp: Creates a new agent in this project. Its provider stays local, including after restart or duplication. Existing conversation history is not copied.
